description: Pure, DB-free domain services + their unit tests: the timetable conflict-detection function (all 5 conflict types, BLOCK/WARN, day-axis math) and the enrollment + faculty-assignment decision helpers (no-duplicate enrollment; soft-transition reassignment that preserves history). These are the unit-testable core the routes (FEAT-003) call. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the generated DayOfWeek enum type + AcademicDayType). Independent of FEAT-003/004.
steps: Read context.json + design.md §8 (conflict detection) and §6.7 (FacultyAssignment immutability invariant) FIRST.

Create apps/api/src/services/timetable-conflict.ts exporting detectTimetableConflicts(ctx: ConflictContext): ConflictReport, DB-free, mirroring the student-sis.ts/calendar-service.ts pure-logic style. Implement: DOW_INDEX {SUN:0..SAT:6} + weekdayOf(slot) using getUTCDay() for one-off dates (§8.2 — getUTCDay NOT getDay; the DayOfWeek ordinal lives only in DOW_INDEX, no SQL compares it numerically, NIT-2); same-day-axis overlap a.start<b.end && b.start<a.end; the 5 checks with severity per §8.2.1 — INVALID_PERIOD (BLOCK: startTime>=endTime or <0 or endTime>1440), FACULTY_DOUBLE_BOOKED (BLOCK), ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED (BLOCK, only when room non-null), SECTION_SELF_CONFLICT (BLOCK), OUT_OF_HOURS (WARN); recurring out-of-hours = workingDaysOfWeek membership ONLY, one-off = explicit effectiveDayType wins else workingDaysOfWeek fallback (§8.2.1 rule); ignore CANCELLED on both sides; exclude the edited slot's own id from self-compare. Output ConflictReport { blocking: Conflict[]; warnings: Conflict[] } with the §8.3 Conflict shape.

Create apps/api/src/services/__tests__/timetable-conflict.test.ts covering EACH conflict type, BLOCK-vs-WARN, the touching-not-overlapping boundary (a.end==b.start => no conflict), recurring-vs-one-off day-axis match (a one-off date whose UTC weekday equals a recurring slot's dayOfWeek collides), getUTCDay determinism, CANCELLED-ignored, edited-slot self-exclusion, and the working-day resolution split by slot kind.

Create apps/api/src/services/class-enrollment.ts (DB-free decision for duplicate-enrollment: resolve by (classSectionId, studentId); the single student identity is the shared StudentProfile — never a second copy) and apps/api/src/services/faculty-assignment.ts (DB-free decision for assign/reassign/substitute: a swap ENDS the current ACTIVE row (status ACTIVE->ENDED + endedAt) and INSERTs a new row for the new faculty/role, emitting a FACULTY_REASSIGNED revision payload; facultyId/subjectId/classSectionId/academicTermId/role immutable after insert — §6.7).

Create apps/api/src/services/__tests__/class-enrollment.test.ts and apps/api/src/services/__tests__/faculty-assignment.test.ts (incl. a preserve-history assertion: the prior assignment row is retained, not overwritten, on a substitute swap).
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -w @campusgate/api -- timetable-conflict` passes with a case for every conflict type (INVALID_PERIOD, FACULTY_DOUBLE_BOOKED, ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED, SECTION_SELF_CONFLICT, OUT_OF_HOURS) and BLOCK/WARN, boundary, recurring-vs-one-off, CANCELLED-ignored, and self-exclude cases.
`npm test -w @campusgate/api -- class-enrollment faculty-assignment` passes, including the preserve-history (soft-transition retains prior rows) assertion.
`npm run build -w @campusgate/api` typechecks the new service modules against the FEAT-001 generated types.
findings:
COMPLETED. Three DB-free pure service modules + unit tests added under apps/api/src/services (+ __tests__). All 3 verification commands green: `npm test -w @campusgate/api -- timetable-conflict class-enrollment faculty-assignment` = 44 passed (3 files); `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` (prisma generate + tsc) clean. No routes, no DB I/O, no schema/migration changes. Committed locally on main, not pushed.

EXPORTED SIGNATURES FEAT-003 (routes) WILL CALL:

=== apps/api/src/services/timetable-conflict.ts ===
- `const DOW_INDEX: Record<DayOfWeek, number>` — SUN:0..SAT:6, the ONLY place the enum becomes an integer (NIT-2; no numeric SQL compare).
- `function weekdayOf(slot: SlotInput): number | null` — recurring => DOW_INDEX[dayOfWeek]; one-off => new Date(slot.date).getUTCDay() (getUTCDay, NOT getDay); one-off with no date => null.
- `function detectTimetableConflicts(ctx: ConflictContext): ConflictReport` — the entry point.
- `interface SlotInput { id?: string; classSectionId: string; facultyId: string; room: string | null; dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek | null; date: string | null; startTime: number; endTime: number; status: 'SCHEDULED' | 'CANCELLED'; }` — date is an ISO date STRING (not Date). startTime/endTime are minutes from midnight.
- `interface ConflictContext { candidate: SlotInput; existing: SlotInput[]; dayType: AcademicDayType | null; workingDaysOfWeek: number[]; }` — route fetches term-scoped SCHEDULED existing slots in-tenant, the candidate's effectiveDayType (one-off only; null for recurring/none), and InstitutionConfig.workingDaysOfWeek (0..6 aligned to DOW_INDEX/getUTCDay).
- `type ConflictType = 'INVALID_PERIOD' | 'FACULTY_DOUBLE_BOOKED' | 'ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED' | 'SECTION_SELF_CONFLICT' | 'OUT_OF_HOURS'`.
- `interface Conflict { type: ConflictType; severity: 'BLOCK' | 'WARN'; message: string; conflictingScheduledClassId?: string; detail?: Record<string, string | number>; }`.
- `interface ConflictReport { blocking: Conflict[]; warnings: Conflict[]; }` — route: blocking.length>0 => HTTP 409 (do NOT write); warnings-only => 200/201 with warnings in the envelope (§8.3). INVALID_PERIOD/FACULTY_DOUBLE_BOOKED/ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED/SECTION_SELF_CONFLICT are BLOCK; OUT_OF_HOURS is WARN. CANCELLED slots ignored both sides; candidate.id excluded from self-compare. Room compared only when non-null on both. Recurring OUT_OF_HOURS = workingDaysOfWeek membership ONLY (effectiveDayType NOT consulted); one-off = explicit dayType wins (WORKING_DAY/SPECIAL_WORKING_DAY/EXAM_DAY/INSTITUTION_EVENT => working; HOLIDAY/WEEKEND/VACATION => non-working) else workingDaysOfWeek fallback. Overlap is half-open: a.end===b.start is NOT a conflict.

=== apps/api/src/services/class-enrollment.ts ===
- `function decideEnrollment(input: EnrollmentDecisionInput): EnrollmentDecision`.
- `interface ExistingEnrollment { id: string; status: 'ENROLLED' | 'DROPPED' | 'COMPLETED'; }`.
- `interface EnrollmentDecisionInput { classSectionId: string; studentId: string; existing: ExistingEnrollment | null; capacity: number | null; enrolledCount: number; }` — `existing` is the at-most-one row for this (classSectionId, studentId) resolved in-tenant.
- `type EnrollmentDecision = { action: 'enroll' } | { action: 'reject'; reason: 'duplicate' } | { action: 'reject'; reason: 'capacity_full' } | { action: 'reenroll'; enrollmentId: string }`. Resolution order: live ENROLLED => reject(duplicate); capped & full => reject(capacity_full); prior DROPPED/COMPLETED => reenroll (reactivate the SAME row — single (section,student) identity, never a 2nd row); else enroll. Route maps duplicate=>409, capacity_full=>409. Capacity soft-overshoot under concurrency accepted (design A9).

=== apps/api/src/services/faculty-assignment.ts ===
- `function decideAssign(input: AssignInput): FacultyAssignmentDecision` — fresh assign; returns { action:'assign'; newAssignment } (no revision — route writes classes.faculty.assigned audit only).
- `function decideReassignment(current: AssignmentSnapshot, next: { facultyId: string; role: FacultyAssignmentRole }, now: Date): FacultyAssignmentDecision` — the §6.7 soft-transition swap.
- `interface AssignmentSnapshot { id: string; facultyId: string; subjectId: string; classSectionId: string | null; academicTermId: string; role: FacultyAssignmentRole; status: 'ACTIVE' | 'ENDED'; }`.
- `interface AssignInput { facultyId; subjectId; classSectionId: string|null; academicTermId; role: FacultyAssignmentRole; }`.
- `interface EndTransition { assignmentId: string; status: 'ENDED'; endedAt: Date; }` — the ONLY permitted in-place mutation on the replaced row (ACTIVE->ENDED + endedAt); identity columns untouched => prior row RETAINED as history.
- `interface NewAssignment { facultyId; subjectId; classSectionId: string|null; academicTermId; role: FacultyAssignmentRole; status: 'ACTIVE'; }` — the new row inherits subject/section/term of the ended row; only facultyId+role move.
- `interface ReassignmentRevision { changeType: 'FACULTY_REASSIGNED'; previousFacultyId: string; newFacultyId: string; metadata: { subjectId: string; classSectionId: string | null; role: FacultyAssignmentRole; endedAssignmentId: string; }; }`.
- `type FacultyAssignmentDecision = { action: 'assign'; newAssignment: NewAssignment } | { action: 'reassign'; end: EndTransition; newAssignment: NewAssignment; revision: ReassignmentRevision }`. Route applies end + insert + ScheduleRevision(FACULTY_REASSIGNED) + AuditEvent in ONE withTenant tx. Never an UPDATE of facultyId on an existing row.

TYPES imported from @campusgate/db (re-exported from @prisma/client): DayOfWeek, AcademicDayType, FacultyAssignmentRole. All as both type + runtime value.
